beats.label: Witness
beats.doctrine: Receive the offering as signal, not as belief.

beats.label: Fracture
beats.doctrine: Name the hidden assumptions the offering stands on.

beats.label: Probe
beats.doctrine: Find the strongest honest counter, and let it strike.

beats.label: Distill
beats.doctrine: Keep only the lesson that survives the collision.

beats.label: Transmit
beats.doctrine: Phrase it so a stranger can carry it forward.

beats.label: Recurse
beats.doctrine: Return a sharper question. The loop is the point.
